description:
REQUIRES: opi-fin.6.1 (Host behaviour + Stub) merged first.

FILES: Session supervisor/runner (find where OctoPi.Agent.start_session or equivalent is called), api.ex

GOAL: The real Host GenServer is started per session under the session supervisor, alongside Extension.Manager (opi-fin.3.1). bind_core is rewired to delegate to it so zero extension code changes.

SESSION SUPERVISION TREE (establish this structure in this ticket):
  Session.Supervisor (one_for_one)
  ├── Extension.Manager   -- starts first; owns extension loading, Agents, ETS tables
  ├── Host.Server         -- starts second; implements Host behaviour
  ├── Registry            -- session-scoped, keys: :duplicate (custom event pub/sub)
  └── Session.Runner      -- starts last; receives refs from Manager and Host

STARTUP SEQUENCE MATTERS:
Extension.Manager must start before Session.Runner because the Runner needs the ETS table refs (via Extension.Manager.table_refs/1) to create Context for dispatch. Host.Server must start before Session.Runner because the Runner needs the Host pid for Context. Use :one_for_one with children listed in startup order.

STEP 1 -- Create the production Host GenServer:
- New module OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Host.Server implementing Host behaviour
- Started as a child of Session.Supervisor
- Receives at start_link: references to transport layer (for send_message), session state (for get_active_tools etc.), agent task pid (for abort)
- Its pid is passed to Session.Runner at startup (not looked up dynamically)

STEP 2 -- Wire bind_core to delegate:
In API.bind_core/2 (api.ex), add a new key :host_pid. When present, generate fn-field implementations that delegate to Host.Server via client API functions from opi-fin.6.1:
  bind_core(api, %{host_pid: host_pid}) generates:
    send_message: fn msg -> Host.send_message(host_pid, msg) end
    get_active_tools: fn -> Host.get_active_tools(host_pid) end
    ... for all action fields
Existing call sites passing individual fn values to bind_core continue to work unchanged.

STEP 3 -- Session.Runner context creation:
Runner builds Context before each dispatch:
  %Context{
    host: host_pid,           -- from Host.Server start
    ui: ui_pid,               -- from TUI (passed in at session start)
    handlers_table: tid,      -- from Extension.Manager.table_refs/1
    ...
  }

NOTE: Extension.Manager is introduced in opi-fin.3.1. That ticket must be merged before this one wires the supervision tree, since the Manager must exist as a module to be listed as a supervisor child.

VALIDATION: Run full test suite. Zero extension tests should fail. Two concurrent Session.Supervisor instances (spin up two in a test) must have fully independent state -- verify by checking that Extension.Manager.extensions/1 returns distinct pids for each session.
title: 6a: Introduce Host GenServer into session supervision tree
